title: Youth Sports Waiver Sign-In Log
subtitle: Capture sport, season, guardian authority, and contact level; confirm equipment and coach release.
description: Youth Sports Waiver records sport, season, guardian authority, contact level, equipment, and coach release. Youth Sports Waiver evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this youth sports waiver attendance and custody reconciliation when staff must document sport and season. Reconcile guardian authority, contact level, equipment, and coach release before the youth sports waiver handoff. Use the season plan, team roster, guardian verification, disclosed contact conditions, equipment issue, coach brief, optional-activity choices, and player release. This acknowledgment concerns a player in a team season with practice and competition, contact level, coach supervision, protective gear, league rules, sideline release, and guardian choice. Ask the assigned youth sports waiver reviewer to confirm sport against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Youth Sports Waiver details
sections.guidance: Name sport, season, team, participant and guardian authority, contact level, equipment, coaching supervision, alternative activity, and release. Record the youth sports waiver decision separately from attendance, registration, or routine operations.

sections.title: Youth Sports Waiver participant identity and waiver-status review
sections.guidance: Match each participant to the named activity, current waiver version, signer or guardian status, and participation limit.

blocks.label: Youth Sports Waiver roster boundary
blocks.guidance: Check-in does not replace a completed waiver choice. Route any missing signer, outdated version, participation limit, or unanswered question before participation.

sections.title: Youth Sports Waiver decision and participant reconciliation
sections.guidance: Reconcile participant count, waiver status, and every open question before close.
